problem_type: Terminal export result loses safe explanation and executable next action
symptom: Task center export failures show only failed and no way back; successful exports have no file action.
direct_cause: ExportJobManager drops error codes; export projection drops terminal actions and TaskRow hides the safe error.
class_root: Export result projection has no terminal explanation and action invariant.
affected_population: All export jobs, including persisted terminal jobs
internal_only_reason: Internal task projections and existing desktop navigation API define this invariant.
invariants: Known error codes become localized explanations, raw diagnostics never become task row text.
Terminal jobs have an actionable file or preview destination.
generality_proof: All live and restored exports pass through the same snapshot serializer and task projection. Known code mapping and explicit unknown explanation apply regardless of encoder or caller.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project safe reasons and real terminal actions for all jobs.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both live and historical snapshots are mapped here.
Already uses localized reason and real timeline action.
Import failure nodes already explain local copy failure and expose retry import.

recurrence.reason: Every export failure and persisted terminal job can reproduce.
same_class_scan: rg showInFolder and error in exportJobManager/taskCenter
Read adoptionReceipt failure actions and assetImportAdapter retryLocalAssetImport

prevention.invariant: Terminal export rows carry safe reasons and executable recovery or result action.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown or missing code has an honest localized unknown explanation; missing results return to preview.
prevention.strategy: Preserve error code upstream and derive all terminal actions at projection boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unconditional terminal null action and bare failed explanation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing desktop bridge and internal projections; no dependency behavior changes.

migration: No persisted migration; legacy errors without code retain honest unknown reason and return action.
residual_risks: Real Electron file reveal and project hydration must be verified by the parent agent.
